title: 现在完成时(一):have / has + 过去分词
summary: 表示过去发生的动作对现在的影响,或从过去持续到现在的状态,是第二年最重要的时态。

title: 现在完成时 vs 一般过去时
summary: 两姐妹长得像,分工不同:一般过去时谈"过去的事",现在完成时强调"对现在的影响"。

title: 现在完成进行时:have been doing
summary: 强调动作从过去持续到现在、而且"还在进行"或"刚刚停下",常和 for / all day 搭配。

title: 宾语从句(一):that / if / whether 与连接词
summary: 把一个句子当宾语"装进"另一个句子,是口语中转述和提问的基石。

title: 过去进行时:was / were doing
summary: 描述"过去某个时刻正在进行的动作",也是讲故事的背景画笔。

title: used to 与 would:过去的习惯
summary: 谈"过去常做、现在不再"的事,used to 最稳,would 只能配动作动词。

title: 被动语态(一):一般时态的被动
summary: 当"谁做的"不重要或不知道时,把宾语推上主语位,重点落在动作承受者。

title: 定语从句(一):who / which / that
summary: 像贴在名词后面的"补充标签",把两个句子缝成一句,让表达立刻紧凑。

title: 非谓语动词(一):动名词 doing
summary: 把动作"名词化",喜欢什么、擅长什么、坚持什么,后面都跟 doing。

title: 非谓语动词(二):不定式 to do
summary: 表"目的"与"将要发生的动作",want、decide、hope 后面都跟着它。

title: 动名词与不定式辨析:remember / forget / stop / try
summary: 同一动词,后面跟 doing 还是 to do,意思会发生转向,是 B1 的经典考点。

title: 非谓语动词(三):分词作定语与状语
summary: 现在分词"令人……",过去分词"感到……";放在句首还能当状语,句子立刻精炼。

title: 名词性从句(二):主语从句与表语从句
summary: 句子不仅能当宾语,还能当主语和表语;what 兼任"成分",that 只是"连接"。

title: 状语从句拓展:although / even if / in case
summary: 让步、退一步的假设、以防万一——这三个连接词让你的句子有"弹性"。

title: 综合演练:时态、从句与非谓语
summary: 把这一年学的时态、从句、非谓语放进同一段真实语境,查缺补漏的一课。

title: 过去完成时:had done
summary: 表示"过去的过去":在某过去动作/时间点之前已完成的动作,统一用 had + 过去分词。

title: 将来进行时与将来完成时
summary: will be doing 强调"将来某时刻正在进行";will have done 强调"到将来某点已完成"。

title: 被动语态(二):情态动词与进行时被动
summary: 情态动词后接 be done;现在/过去进行时被动为 be being done / was being done。

title: 定语从句(二):where / when / why
summary: 关系副词 where/when/why 在从句中作状语,先行词分别为地点/时间/原因(reason)。

title: 直接引语与间接引语
summary: 转述别人话时注意:人称、时态后移、时间地点状语变化及句型(陈述用 that,疑问用 if/wh,命令用 tell sb to do)。

title: it 作形式主语与形式宾语
summary: it 代替不定式/动名词/从句,让句子头轻脚重:It is... to do / think it... to do。

title: 目的与结果状语从句:so that / such...that
summary: so that + 目的(常含 can/could/may);so + adj./adv. + that 与 such + 名词 + that 表结果。

title: Present perfect have/has + past participle · 要点精讲
summary: have/has + past participle expresses an action that happened in the past and its impact on the present.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:Present perfect emphasizes the present result and impact of a past action。

title: Present perfect vs past simple · 要点精讲
summary: Determine the tense by whether there is a past time adverbial and whether the present result matters.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:Present perfect emphasizes impact on the present; past simple states a past event with an explicit past time。

title: for / since time phrases · 要点精讲
summary: The time adverbials of the present perfect: for takes a duration, since takes a starting point.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:for + length of time; since + point in time。

title: Past continuous · 要点精讲
summary: The past continuous depicts what was happening at a certain past time.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:was/were + V-ing indicates an action in progress at a past moment。

title: when / while and the past continuous · 要点精讲
summary: was/were doing + when + past simple: the continuous is the background, the past simple is the interrupting event.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:The longer action in the past continuous is the background; the shorter action in the past simple interrupts it。

title: Past perfect · 要点精讲
summary: The past perfect expresses an action completed before a past reference point: by the time / before / after.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:had + past participle indicates 'past of the past'。

title: Passive voice in the present · 要点精讲
summary: The passive voice in the present: be + past participle, emphasizing the receiver of the action.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:am/is/are + past participle; the receiver of the action becomes the subject。

title: Passive voice in the past · 要点精讲
summary: The passive voice in the past depicts a past action from the receiver's perspective.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:was/were + past participle。

title: Modal passive can be done · 要点精讲
summary: Modal verbs in the passive: can/must/should + be + past participle.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:Modal verb + be + past participle。

title: Relative clauses who / that (people) · 要点精讲
summary: A relative clause modifies a person: who/that replaces the antecedent inside the clause.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:who/that introduces a relative clause modifying a person, as subject or object。

title: Relative clauses which / that (things) · 要点精讲
summary: A relative clause modifies a thing: which/that; the clause follows right after the antecedent.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:which/that introduces a relative clause modifying a thing。

title: Relative clauses where / when · 要点精讲
summary: Relational adverbs introduce relative clauses: where = in which, when = on which.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:where modifies a place, when modifies a time, acting as an adverbial inside the clause。

title: Object clauses with that · 要点精讲
summary: An object clause serves as the object of a verb like say/think/know/believe; the word order must be statement order.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:that introduces an object clause; the clause uses statement word order。

title: Object clauses with if / whether and question words · 要点精讲
summary: if/whether and special question words introduce object clauses; the key exam point is word order.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:Object clauses with question words still use statement word order。

title: Adverbial clauses of time with when / before / after · 要点精讲
summary: A time adverbial clause introduced by when/before/after/as soon as; the future is expressed with the present.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:The tense in the time clause: main clause future, subordinate clause present。

title: First conditional if...will · 要点精讲
summary: First conditional: if + present, main clause will + base verb, expressing a real future possibility.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:If clause present, main clause future (will); subordinate clause never uses will。

title: Adverbial clauses of reason with because / since / as · 要点精讲
summary: Reason adverbial clauses: because is strongest, since/as introduce reasons both sides already know.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:because gives a direct reason; since/as gives a known reason; tone weakens in turn。

title: Adverbial clauses of concession with although / though · 要点精讲
summary: although/though introduces a concession: cannot be used together with but.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:although + clause: 'although...but' cannot be used together in the same sentence。

title: Adverbials of purpose with to / in order to · 要点精讲
summary: Adverbials of purpose express purpose: to/in order to + base verb, so that + clause.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:to + base verb = in order to; so that introduces a clause。

title: Infinitives as object want to do · 要点精讲
summary: Verbs like want, decide, hope, plan, promise are followed by the infinitive as object.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:want/decide/hope/plan + to + base verb。

title: Gerunds as object enjoy doing · 要点精讲
summary: Verbs like enjoy, finish, practice, mind, keep are followed by the gerund as object.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:enjoy/finish/practice/mind/keep + V-ing。

title: Gerunds after prepositions · 要点精讲
summary: A verb after a preposition takes the gerund: at/in/on/of/for/about + V-ing.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:Prepositions are followed by V-ing: be good at doing, be interested in doing。

title: so...that / too...to / enough to · 要点精讲
summary: Three result structures: so...that, too...to (negative meaning), enough to (affirmative meaning).本课为要点精讲练习,核心:so + adjective + that clause; too + adjective + to do; adjective + enough + to do。

title: Tag questions · 要点精讲
summary: Tag questions: front affirmative, tag negative, and vice versa; reuse the be/auxiliary/modal of the main clause.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:Affirmative in the front, negative in the tag; the tense and pronoun of the tag match the main clause。

title: Exclamatory sentences What / How · 要点精讲
summary: Exclamatory sentences start with What or How: What a/an + adjective + singular noun; How + adjective.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:What + noun phrase; How + adjective/adorb。

title: both / either / neither · 要点精讲
summary: both/either/neither express the quantity relationships of two objects; mind singular and plural agreement.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:both = both (affirmative), neither = neither (negative), either = either of two options。

title: used to past habits · 要点精讲
summary: used to expresses a past habit or state that no longer exists.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:used to + base verb = often did something in the past (not now)。
